raw:
Challenge the **80-hour replacement installation downtime** first.

- It directly conflicts with your next-quarter objective: lost production occurs before the higher reliability and capacity become available.
- It is entirely Olumi’s illustrative assumption, not your evidence.
- Test the full “out of service to stable output” period — delivery, installation, commissioning, operator ramp-up and contingency — rather than installation alone.

The **£40,000 replacement cost** is also pivotal because it sits exactly on your stated cap, leaving no contingency.
